<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="nws8H5KJdMxfw1pR7ns-"> <mxGraphModel dx="1233" dy="1426" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="light-dark(#ffffff, #121212)" math="0" shadow="1"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% METODOS AUXILIARES
 subgraph AUX [\"Métodos Auxiliares\"]
 direction TB
 A1([__init__]) --> A2[Asignar kp, ki, kd y default_dt]
 A2 --> A3[Inicializar: prev_error = 0.0, integral = 0.0, last_time = None]
 
 B1([reset]) --> B2[Limpiar estado: prev_error = 0.0, integral = 0.0, last_time = None]
 end

 %% METODO COMPUTE
 subgraph COMP [\"Método compute(setpoint, measured_value)\"]
 direction TB
 C1([Inicio compute]) --> C2[current_time = time.monotonic]
 
 %% Gestión de tiempo dt
 C2 --> C3{¿last_time es None?}
 C3 -- SÍ --> C4[dt = default_dt]
 C3 -- NO --> C5[dt = current_time - last_time]
 
 C4 --> C6{¿dt <= 0.0?}
 C5 --> C6
 
 C6 -- SÍ --> C7[dt = 1e-6]
 C6 -- NO --> C8[error = setpoint - measured_value]
 C7 --> C8
 
 %% Término Integral y Anti-windup
 C8 --> C9[integral += error * dt]
 C9 --> C10[Anti-windup: Limitar integral entre -100.0 y 100.0]
 
 %% Término Derivativo
 C10 --> C11{¿last_time no es None?}
 C11 -- SÍ --> C12[derivative = error - prev_error / dt]
 C11 -- NO --> C13[derivative = 0.0]
 
 %% Actualización y Salida
 C12 --> C14[prev_error = error<br/>last_time = current_time]
 C13 --> C14
 
 C14 --> C15[Resultado = kp * error + ki * integral + kd * derivative]
 C15 --> C16([Retornar Resultado])
 end",
 "config": null
